title: IP address allocation via NAS signalling

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates PDU session establishment and has IP stack capabilities.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to request establishment of a PDU session for IP connectivity.

entities.name: PDU session type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating requested IP version capability (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6).

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element used to indicate DHCPv4 usage for IPv4 address assignment.

entities.name: Selected PDU session type IE
entities.description: Information element set by network indicating final selected IP version.

entities.name: PDU address IE
entities.description: Information element containing allocated IP address(es) from network.

entities.name: UE IP capability condition
entities.description: Condition based on UE's IP stack capabilities (IPv6/IPv4 capable, IPv6 only, IPv4 only, or unknown).

entities.name: DHCPv4 usage condition
entities.description: Condition when UE wants to use DHCPv4 for IPv4 address assignment.

entities.name: IP address allocation
entities.description: Network behavior to allocate IP addresses based on PDU session type, operator policies, and subscription data.

relations.description: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains PDU session type IE.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains Extended protocol configuration options IE.
UE IP capability condition determines the value set in PDU session type IE.
DHCPv4 usage condition determines content in Extended protocol configuration options IE.
IP address allocation process establishes the Selected PDU session type IE value.
Selected PDU session type IE value determines the content of PDU address IE.
UE's IP stack capabilities establish the IP capability condition.
